title: Read odometry structure
description: Find position, velocity and the raw orientation quaternion in Odometry. Converting that quaternion to yaw is the next exercise.
steps: Inspect /odom with echo --field pose.pose, then compare pose with twist.twist velocity.
Subscribe to Odometry. Read position.x and position.y; inspect orientation.z and orientation.w without converting them yet.
Report x and y with report_position(x, y). Try a one-shot Twist in another terminal and observe position versus velocity.
hints: Position is msg.pose.pose.position; orientation is msg.pose.pose.orientation.
Velocity is in msg.twist.twist, which is different from the accumulated pose.
Use report_position(position.x, position.y). Quaternion-to-yaw conversion comes in 5.2.

nl.title: De structuur van odometrie lezen
nl.description: Zoek positie, snelheid en de ruwe oriëntatiequaternion in Odometry. Omzetten naar yaw volgt in 5.2.
steps: Inspecteer /odom met echo --field pose.pose en vergelijk pose met twist.twist-snelheid.
Abonneer je op Odometry. Lees position.x en position.y; bekijk orientation.z en orientation.w zonder ze al om te zetten.
Meld x en y met report_position(x, y). Stuur in een ander terminal een Twist met --once en vergelijk positie met snelheid.
hints: Positie staat in msg.pose.pose.position; oriëntatie in msg.pose.pose.orientation.
Snelheid staat in msg.twist.twist en is iets anders dan de opgebouwde pose.
Gebruik report_position(position.x, position.y). Quaternion naar yaw volgt in 5.2.

fr.title: Lire la structure de l’odométrie
fr.description: Repérez position, vitesse et quaternion brut dans Odometry. La conversion en yaw vient en 5.2.
steps: Inspectez /odom avec echo --field pose.pose, puis comparez pose et vitesse twist.twist.
Abonnez-vous à Odometry. Lisez position.x et position.y ; observez orientation.z et orientation.w sans les convertir.
Transmettez x et y avec report_position(x, y). Envoyez un Twist --once dans un autre terminal et comparez position et vitesse.
hints: La position est dans msg.pose.pose.position ; l’orientation dans msg.pose.pose.orientation.
La vitesse est dans msg.twist.twist, distincte de la pose accumulée.
Utilisez report_position(position.x, position.y). La conversion quaternion→yaw vient en 5.2.

es.title: Leer la estructura de odometría
es.description: Localiza posición, velocidad y el cuaternión bruto en Odometry. La conversión a yaw viene en 5.2.
steps: Inspecciona /odom con echo --field pose.pose y compara pose con la velocidad twist.twist.
Suscríbete a Odometry. Lee position.x y position.y; observa orientation.z y orientation.w sin convertirlos aún.
Informa x e y con report_position(x, y). Envía un Twist --once desde otro terminal y compara posición y velocidad.
hints: La posición está en msg.pose.pose.position; la orientación en msg.pose.pose.orientation.
La velocidad está en msg.twist.twist y no es la pose acumulada.
Usa report_position(position.x, position.y). La conversión de cuaternión a yaw viene en 5.2.

de.title: Odometriestruktur lesen
de.description: Finde Position, Geschwindigkeit und das rohe Orientierungsquaternion in Odometry. Die Umrechnung in Yaw folgt in 5.2.
steps: Untersuche /odom mit echo --field pose.pose und vergleiche Pose mit der Geschwindigkeit in twist.twist.
Abonniere Odometry. Lies position.x und position.y; betrachte orientation.z und orientation.w noch ohne Umrechnung.
Melde x und y mit report_position(x, y). Sende in einem anderen Terminal einen Twist --once und vergleiche Position und Geschwindigkeit.
hints: Position steht in msg.pose.pose.position; Orientierung in msg.pose.pose.orientation.
Geschwindigkeit steht in msg.twist.twist und ist nicht die aufsummierte Pose.
Nutze report_position(position.x, position.y). Quaternion zu Yaw folgt in 5.2.

pt.title: Ler a estrutura da odometria
pt.description: Encontra posição, velocidade e o quaternion bruto em Odometry. A conversão para yaw vem em 5.2.
steps: Inspeciona /odom com echo --field pose.pose e compara pose com a velocidade em twist.twist.
Subscreve Odometry. Lê position.x e position.y; observa orientation.z e orientation.w sem converter ainda.
Reporta x e y com report_position(x, y). Envia um Twist --once noutro terminal e compara posição e velocidade.
hints: A posição está em msg.pose.pose.position; a orientação em msg.pose.pose.orientation.
A velocidade está em msg.twist.twist e difere da pose acumulada.
Usa report_position(position.x, position.y). A conversão de quaternion para yaw vem em 5.2.

it.title: Leggere la struttura dell’odometria
it.description: Trova posizione, velocità e quaternione grezzo in Odometry. La conversione in yaw arriva in 5.2.
steps: Esamina /odom con echo --field pose.pose e confronta pose con la velocità in twist.twist.
Iscriviti a Odometry. Leggi position.x e position.y; osserva orientation.z e orientation.w senza convertirli.
Riporta x e y con report_position(x, y). Invia un Twist --once da un altro terminale e confronta posizione e velocità.
hints: La posizione è in msg.pose.pose.position; l’orientamento in msg.pose.pose.orientation.
La velocità è in msg.twist.twist ed è diversa dalla pose accumulata.
Usa report_position(position.x, position.y). La conversione da quaternione a yaw arriva in 5.2.
